item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00187","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C16","C25","C13"],"selected_candidate_label":"C16","confidence":0.99,"relationship_type":"literal_language_template","rationale":"C16 supplies the concrete substance and distinctive wording of the child's two newly assigned areas of responsibility. The child converts C16's operative duties of the Operations Coordinating Board into personal instructions to Harr: initiating proposals in response to opportunities and changed circumstances, and ensuring that implementation contributes to the desired climate of foreign opinion. C25 contains essentially the same underlying provisions, but C16 is the closer and more recent governing formulation. C13 is relevant to the Board's membership and presidential representatives but does not supply the child's core duties.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"taking the lead in initiating new proposals to the Board for actions within the framework of national security policies in response to opportunity and changes in the situation","parent_excerpt":"initiate new proposals for action within the framework of national security policies in response to opportunity and changes in the situation","explanation":"This is nearly verbatim reuse of C16's operative language, adapted from a duty of the Board to a specific responsibility assigned to Harr."},{"child_excerpt":"placing particular emphasis on seeing that Board actions implementing national security policies contribute fully to the climate of foreign opinion the United States is seeking to achieve in the world","parent_excerpt":"the execution of each security action or project so that it shall make its full contribution to the attainment of national security objectives and to the particular climate of opinion the United States is seeking to achieve in the world","explanation":"The child closely adapts C16's distinctive climate-of-opinion standard into an oversight responsibility for Harr."},{"child_excerpt":"continue as Vice Chairman of the OCB ... present OCB reports to the National Security Council","parent_excerpt":"The Board shall have a chairman and a vice chairman, each of whom shall be designated by the President from among its members ... [and] shall from time to time make reports to the National Security Council","explanation":"C16 provides the institutional machinery underlying Harr's continuing vice-chairmanship and reporting role, though this evidence is less distinctive than the two operative duties."}]}
